exceptions.justification: Existing compatibility coverage for the editor facade remains centralized here while focused editor-family test modules own new behavior; this baseline may not silently grow.

After the composition-test ownership audit, this class is the retained cross-subsystem TUI composition suite; focused subsystem behavior belongs in focused test modules and this baseline may not silently grow.
Mixed-language synthesis currently owns one transactional Voiceger override and timing-capture lifecycle; the existing method is reviewed at its current size but may not silently grow.

The compatibility facade still coordinates several focused editor owners through one controller class; new feature behavior belongs in those focused owners and this direct-method baseline may not silently grow.

The shared operation-lifecycle facade remains the composition point for focused playback, conflict, acceptance, and worker-event owners; new responsibilities must stay in focused owners and this baseline may not silently grow.

Dictionary rendering currently builds the related menu, import, list, filter, entry, and detail documents through one focused dispatch function; the current span is reviewed but may not silently grow.
